awn_deluxe.title: Ashes Without Number, Deluxe Edition
awn_deluxe.availability: authorised copy supplied by the author; read on 2026-11-03 and indexed from its own table of contents; not redistributable, not in the repository
awn_deluxe.rights: no verified open-text licence; mechanics re-expressed independently, pages cited only

source.swn_url_note: The URL listed in the tracker points at Stars Without Number Revised, not AWN; it is used for SWN compatibility only.

statuses.verified: an AWN procedure implemented in src/rules with tests that pin the printed numbers
statuses.verified_reuse: the identical procedure already exists for CWN; one resolver is shared and a test proves the AWN numbers
statuses.partial: some of the section is implemented and the remainder is named
statuses.documented: a tabletop procedure exists and is cited; the source asks for a procedure, not code
statuses.unverified: an equivalent CWN procedure exists but equivalence to the AWN numbers has not been proven
statuses.missing: no implementation; the gap is recorded so it cannot be mistaken for coverage
statuses.not_applicable: setting text, an example, guidance, or content excluded by an explicit decision

rows.title: The Fires that Consume
rows.note: Opening fiction/history (p.1); setting, not a rule.

rows.title: Character Creation
rows.note: Chapter opening (p.4); its procedures are the rows below.

rows.title: Attributes
rows.note: AWN uses the Without Number attribute band (p.5), which wn_core already implements and a test pins against the printed table.

rows.title: Skills
rows.note: 2d6 + skill + attribute modifier with the -1 unskilled penalty (p.5); the shared resolver, not a second one.

rows.title: Choosing a Background
rows.note: AWN background tables (p.7) are not implemented; CWN backgrounds are a different table and are not a substitute.

rows.title: Edges

rows.title: Mutations

rows.title: Stigmas
rows.note: Stigmas (p.17) are unimplemented optional content.

rows.title: Negative Mutations
rows.note: Negative mutations (p.18) are unimplemented optional content.

rows.title: Positive Mutations

rows.title: Foci

rows.title: Hit Points, Attack Bonus, and Saves
